_comment: Physical colour order per span, relative to the WLED bus (GRB).  Re-measured 2026-10-27 with mau5hue, which asks each LED for red and then for green and compares how much red came back -- a single red frame is not enough, because the camera's white balance drifts between shots and turns the answer over.  The swapped span is 492-529, two LEDs longer than the 492-527 measured earlier; those two were the green corner on the ear outline.
